data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were $444.2m. The syndicate reports a net prior-year reserves release of $8.6m in 2022, primarily attributable to favourable claims development on older years of the market facilities book. Material drivers referenced in the report include favourable development on older market facilities exposures, while recent years experienced adverse activity from events such as Hurricane Ian and prior pandemic-related impacts on the personal accident book. The available quantified prior-year movement is reported on a net basis in the strategic commentary; no gross prior-year movement figure is provided in isolation.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate has prior year reserves releases of $8.6m in 2022 (2021: $36.9m), primarily driven by claims releases on the older years of account of the market facilities book.
The 2020 year of account declares a loss on capacity of 1.5%, due to adverse claims activity in its personal accident and market facilities books following the COVID-19 global pandemic.
The claims ratio increased to 35% in 2022 (2021: 26%). This is being driven the events outlined in the outlook section of this strategic report.
The 2022 underwriting year has also experienced adverse claims activity as a result of Hurricane Ian.

data.data_quality_notes: The only explicit quantified prior year reserve movement in the report is described in the strategic narrative as a $8.6m release; that figure appears to be a net (after reinsurance) amount. No explicit gross (insurance liabilities) 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line showing a gross figure was found. A gross claims development triangle is provided (percentages and ultimate amounts) but a direct gross PYD reconciliation line is not present. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the reported net prior-year release and is flagged accordingly.
